payload.title: Expose and fence the heartbeat via the CLI
payload.body: heartbeat() exists on the backend but no CLI command or agent loop calls it, so a task that outlives its lease cannot renew -> another machine steals it while the owner is still working -> two agents on one task. Add tasks heartbeat <id> --claim <token> and have /next-task renew during long work. Also add a fencing check inside heartbeat so a stale owner whose lease was stolen cannot renew over the new owner.
